interface.signature: def isPossible(N: int, P: int, prerequisites: list[set[int]]) -> bool:

preconditions.description: N is the number of tasks (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^4) and P is the number of prerequisite pairs (1 ≤ P ≤ 10^5).

preconditions.expression: all(len(pair) == 2 for pair in prerequisites) and all(0 <= task < N for pair in prerequisites for task in pair)
preconditions.description: Each prerequisite pair contains exactly two distinct task indices, both within the valid range [0, N-1].

postconditions.expression: return_value == (not any(task in [prereq for pair in prerequisites for prereq in pair] for task in range(N)))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if there are no cycles in the prerequisite graph, meaning all tasks can be completed without circular dependencies.
